bib.title: Carbon Emissions and Large Neural Network Training

question: How much energy and CO2e does training recent large NLP models (T5, Meena, GShard, Switch Transformer, GPT-3) and the Evolved Transformer NAS actually cost, and which factors reduce it?
hypothesis: Choice of DNN, processor, datacenter and location can shrink training carbon footprint by orders of magnitude, and earlier retroactive estimates (Strubell et al. NAS) were badly off without measurement.
contributions: Energy and CO2e estimates for T5, Meena, GShard-600B, Switch Transformer and GPT-3
Refined 88X-lower estimate for the Evolved Transformer NAS
Formulas for training energy and carbon footprint
Recommendations: report energy/CO2e, reward efficiency, report processors and training time

method.summary: Computes training energy (hours x processors x measured average power x PUE) and CO2e (energy x grid kg CO2e/KWh) for five large NLP models and NAS, using measured power and performance for Google models and OpenAI-supplied values for GPT-3. Gross and net (24/7 carbon-free energy) CO2e are both given.

other.setup: 8 P100 or 8 TPU v2, WMT En-De accuracy goal

parameters.carbon_formula: tCO2e = KWh x kg CO2e per KWh / 1000

results.note: Table 4 prints 1,287 MWh and 552.1 gross=net tCO2e
results.quote: Its estimated carbon emissions due to training are 552 tCO 2 e and its energy consumption is 1287 MWh.

results.setup: GPT-3 175B on 10,000 V100 GPUs (Microsoft datacenter), 14.8 days, PUE 1.10, US-average 0.429 kg CO2e/KWh, V100 measured 330 W (OpenAI-supplied)

results.claim: T5 (11B) training

results.quote: training used 86 MWh and produced 47 tCO 2 e

results.claim: Meena (2.6B) training

results.claim: Switch Transformer (1500B) training net emissions (an estimate)

results.quote: We estimated it used 179 MWh and produced 59 net tCO 2 e.

results.claim: Sparse GShard vs dense GPT-3: ~45X fewer processor years, ~55X less energy, ~115X less gross and ~130X less net CO2e
results.setup: GShard-600B vs GPT-3 (Table 4); differing hardware and datacenters
results.quote: Compared to the dense GPT-3, sparsely activated Gshard needs ~45X fewer processor years, uses ~55X less energy, and reduces gross CO 2 e ~115X and net CO 2 e ~130X.

results.claim: Choice of DNN, datacenter and processor can cut footprint up to ~100-1000X
results.setup: Abstract; combination of sparse DNN, cloud datacenter and ML accelerator
results.quote: the choice of DNN, datacenter, and processor can reduce the carbon footprint up to ~100-1000X

results.claim: Sparsely activated DNNs can use <1/10th the energy of dense DNNs at equal accuracy
results.setup: Abstract; sparse vs dense, as many or more parameters
results.quote: Large but sparsely activated DNNs can consume <1/10th the energy of large, dense DNNs without sacrificing accuracy

results.claim: Transformer (Big) on P100 in US-average datacenter to Evolved Transformer (Medium) on TPU v2 in Google Iowa: overall CO2e improvement
results.setup: Transformer Big 0.21B on 8 P100 US avg (0.1357 t) vs ET Medium 0.13B on 8 TPU v2 Iowa (net 0.0024 t); WMT En-De accuracy goal
results.quote: the overall improvement in CO 2 e is 57X

results.claim: Earlier Strubell et al. NAS estimate for Evolved Transformer was 88X too high in emissions for Google's actual run
results.setup: Evolved Transformer NAS: 6.8 days, 200 TPU v2, 208 W, PUE 1.10, 0.431 kg/KWh, Georgia; Strubell 284 tCO2e vs 3.2 tCO2e
results.quote: 88X off in emissions for energy-efficient organizations like Google

results.claim: Strubell NAS estimate was 18.7X too high for an average organization (proxy task, smaller batch)
results.setup: Appendix C: Transformer Base proxy (2.3x cheaper per step) and batch 4,096 not 32,768 (8x); 284 t vs 15.2 t
results.quote: energy estimate for NAS ended up 18.7X too high for the average organization

results.claim: Actual Evolved Transformer NAS emissions
results.setup: (6.8 days*24*200 chips*208 W*1.10 PUE/1000 KWh)*0.431 kg/KWh; rerun in Iowa with 24/7 CFE would be 0.6 t

results.claim: Evolved Transformer reuse in Meena saved 48.5 tCO2e, ~15X the NAS cost
results.setup: Meena trained with ET instead of Transformer; vs 3.2 t NAS cost
results.quote: saved 48.5 t CO 2 e during the training of the Meena DNN

results.claim: Evolved Transformer: 37% fewer parameters and 25% less energy to same accuracy than Transformer (Big)
results.setup: WMT English to German translation; ET Medium 0.13B vs Big 0.21B
results.quote: has 37% fewer parameters and converges to the same accuracy with 25% less energy expenditure

limits: Training only; inference energy is acknowledged as the larger share of lifecycle but not measured (Sec 2).
GPT-3 inputs come from OpenAI and NVIDIA press release; GPU count and 14.8 days are not measured by the authors, and Azure carbon intensity is the US average.
Final run only; experimentation and failed runs not counted (Sec 4.2).
Manufacturing and recycling emissions excluded; edge devices excluded.
Net CO2e depends on Google's 24/7 CFE accounting and clean energy purchases; Google models ran where gross and net were similar.
Authors are from Google and include the Evolved Transformer, Meena, T5, GShard, Switch authors; results are self-reported.
